reply: [{"query": "GVP Module V 对未按期提交或内容不达标的 RMP（风险管理计划）规定了具体的罚款金额或处罚标准吗？", "query_en": "Does GVP Module V specify the exact fine amount or sanction for late or non-compliant submission of an RMP?", "topic": "RMP违规罚款金额", "absence_terms": ["fine", "penalty amount", "€", "monetary sanction"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 21, "text": "Mandatory and subject to penalties"}, "rationale": "问题询问 RMP 违规的具体罚款金额，但文档仅在总结表中提及相关研究“subject to penalties”而未给出任何具体处罚标准或金额，此类执行细则属于各成员国国内立法范畴，不在本 GVP 指南范围内详述。"}, {"query": "提交 RMP（风险管理计划）初始版本或更新版本时，申请人需要向主管当局缴纳多少评审费用（fee）？", "query_en": "How much assessment fee must an applicant/marketing authorisation holder pay to the competent authority when submitting an initial or updated RMP?", "topic": "RMP提交评审费用", "absence_terms": ["fee", "€", "invoice", "payment"], "nearest_clause": {"page": 29, "text": "For all new marketing applications, the applicant shall submit the risk management plan describing the risk management system, together with a summary thereof [DIR Art 8(3)(iaa)]."}, "rationale": "问题询问 RMP 提交或评审所需缴纳的具体费用金额，而文档中相关条款只规定了提交义务、格式与内容要求，未涉及任何费用或付款条款，费用事宜通常由各国主管机构的收费法规单独规定。"}]
